leftovers.name: Leftovers
leftovers.desc: The holder restores 1/16 of its max HP at the end of every turn.

choice_band.name: Choice Band
choice_band.desc: Boosts Attack by 50%, but locks the holder into the first move it uses.

choice_specs.name: Choice Specs
choice_specs.desc: Boosts Sp. Atk by 50%, but locks the holder into the first move it uses.

choice_scarf.name: Choice Scarf
choice_scarf.desc: Boosts Speed by 50%, but locks the holder into the first move it uses.

focus_sash.name: Focus Sash
focus_sash.desc: If the holder is at full HP, it survives a knockout blow with 1 HP. Single use.

life_orb.name: Life Orb
life_orb.desc: Boosts move damage by 30%, but the holder loses 10% max HP after each attack.

quick_claw.name: Quick Claw
quick_claw.desc: 20% chance each turn for the holder to move first within its priority bracket.

rocky_helmet.name: Rocky Helmet
rocky_helmet.desc: Attackers striking the holder with physical moves lose 1/6 of their max HP.

assault_vest.name: Assault Vest
assault_vest.desc: Raises Sp. Def by 50%, but the holder cannot select status moves.

eviolite.name: Eviolite
eviolite.desc: Raises Defense and Sp. Def by 50% if the holder can still evolve.

shell_bell.name: Shell Bell
shell_bell.desc: The holder restores HP equal to 1/8 of the damage it deals.

kings_rock.name: King's Rock
kings_rock.desc: The holder's damaging moves gain a 10% chance to make the target flinch.

bright_powder.name: Bright Powder
bright_powder.desc: Moves aimed at the holder are 10% less accurate.

silk_scarf.name: Silk Scarf
silk_scarf.desc: Boosts the power of the holder's Normal-type moves by 20%.

charcoal.name: Charcoal
charcoal.desc: Boosts the power of the holder's Fire-type moves by 20%.

mystic_water.name: Mystic Water
mystic_water.desc: Boosts the power of the holder's Water-type moves by 20%.

miracle_seed.name: Miracle Seed
miracle_seed.desc: Boosts the power of the holder's Grass-type moves by 20%.

magnet.name: Magnet
magnet.desc: Boosts the power of the holder's Electric-type moves by 20%.

never_melt_ice.name: Never-Melt Ice
never_melt_ice.desc: Boosts the power of the holder's Ice-type moves by 20%.

black_belt.name: Black Belt
black_belt.desc: Boosts the power of the holder's Fighting-type moves by 20%.

poison_barb.name: Poison Barb
poison_barb.desc: Boosts the power of the holder's Poison-type moves by 20%.

soft_sand.name: Soft Sand
soft_sand.desc: Boosts the power of the holder's Ground-type moves by 20%.

sharp_beak.name: Sharp Beak
sharp_beak.desc: Boosts the power of the holder's Flying-type moves by 20%.

twisted_spoon.name: Twisted Spoon
twisted_spoon.desc: Boosts the power of the holder's Psychic-type moves by 20%.

silver_powder.name: Silver Powder
silver_powder.desc: Boosts the power of the holder's Bug-type moves by 20%.

hard_stone.name: Hard Stone
hard_stone.desc: Boosts the power of the holder's Rock-type moves by 20%.

spell_tag.name: Spell Tag
spell_tag.desc: Boosts the power of the holder's Ghost-type moves by 20%.

dragon_fang.name: Dragon Fang
dragon_fang.desc: Boosts the power of the holder's Dragon-type moves by 20%.

lum_berry.name: Lum Berry
lum_berry.desc: Cures the holder of any status condition or confusion the moment it strikes. Single use.

sitrus_berry.name: Sitrus Berry
sitrus_berry.desc: Restores 25% max HP when the holder drops to half health or below. Single use.

chesto_berry.name: Chesto Berry
chesto_berry.desc: Wakes the holder the moment it falls asleep. Single use.

cheri_berry.name: Cheri Berry
cheri_berry.desc: Cures the holder of paralysis the moment it is inflicted. Single use.

rawst_berry.name: Rawst Berry
rawst_berry.desc: Heals the holder's burn the moment it is inflicted. Single use.

pecha_berry.name: Pecha Berry
pecha_berry.desc: Cures the holder of poison the moment it is inflicted. Single use.

aspear_berry.name: Aspear Berry
aspear_berry.desc: Thaws the holder the moment it is frozen. Single use.

persim_berry.name: Persim Berry
persim_berry.desc: Snaps the holder out of confusion the moment it sets in. Single use.

potion.name: Potion
potion.desc: Restores 20 HP to one of your Pokémon.

super_potion.name: Super Potion
super_potion.desc: Restores 60 HP to one of your Pokémon.

hyper_potion.name: Hyper Potion
hyper_potion.desc: Restores 120 HP to one of your Pokémon.

max_potion.name: Max Potion
max_potion.desc: Fully restores one of your Pokémon's HP.

full_restore.name: Full Restore
full_restore.desc: Fully restores HP and cures all status conditions and confusion.

full_heal.name: Full Heal
full_heal.desc: Cures all status conditions and confusion on one Pokémon.

revive.name: Revive
revive.desc: Revives a fainted Pokémon with half its max HP.

max_revive.name: Max Revive
max_revive.desc: Revives a fainted Pokémon with full HP.

x_attack.name: X Attack
x_attack.desc: Sharply focuses your active Pokémon: raises Attack by one stage.

x_defense.name: X Defense
x_defense.desc: Raises your active Pokémon's Defense by one stage.

x_sp_atk.name: X Sp. Atk
x_sp_atk.desc: Raises your active Pokémon's Sp. Atk by one stage.

x_sp_def.name: X Sp. Def
x_sp_def.desc: Raises your active Pokémon's Sp. Def by one stage.

x_speed.name: X Speed
x_speed.desc: Raises your active Pokémon's Speed by one stage.

dire_hit.name: Dire Hit
dire_hit.desc: Doubles your active Pokémon's critical-hit chance for the rest of the battle.

guard_spec.name: Guard Spec.
guard_spec.desc: Prevents the opponent from lowering your active Pokémon's stats for 5 turns.

leaf_stone.name: Leaf Stone

moon_stone.name: Moon Stone

sun_stone.name: Sun Stone
sun_stone.desc: A ruddy stone as warm as the sun. Evolves certain Pokémon.

metal_coat.name: Metal Coat
metal_coat.desc: A steel-clad coating. Triggers the evolution of certain Pokémon.

dragon_scale.name: Dragon Scale
dragon_scale.desc: A tough, shimmering scale. Triggers the evolution of certain Pokémon.

up_grade.name: Up-Grade
